questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Forskningsmulighederne, kulturen og outdoor livsstil.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var rimelig okay. Virtual Advising Center er gode at kontakte med sine spørgsmål.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik en del information via email.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Det var lidt udfordrende at navigere i et nyt undervisningssystem, ny måde at tilmelde sig fag etc.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Jeg brugte UCSD off-campus hjemmesiden. Det fungerede fint.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det indebærer, at man selv skal gøre en indsats for at få et socialt netværk (hvilket dog ikke er svært i San Diego) fordi man ikke nødvendigvis får venner, der hvor man bor.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Ikke relevant da jeg selv fandt housing.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det kan være vanskeligt at navigere i, hvordan kursustilmelding fungerer. Mit bedste råd er at kontakte Virtual Advising Center hvis man har spørgsmål.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Virtual Advising Center.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Man får ikke altid plads på de kurser, man ønsker. Jeg blev nød til at ændre en hel del i mine kurser, fordi KU var forsinkede ift. at give svar på forhåndsgodkendelser.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Vær klar og tilmeld dig de ønskede kurser så snart tilmelding åbner.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg tog både graduate og undergraduate kurser. Jeg lavede også forskning (PSYC 199 Independent Studies).

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: En del undergraduate kurser har ugentlige quizzes samt midterms udover den endelige eksamen. De graduate kurser jeg tog var mere diskussionsbaserede og en studerende pr. undervisningsgang holdte oplæg og præsenterede fx. en videnskabelig artikel.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
PSYC 272 Selected Topics in Cognitive Psychology
PSYC 199 Independent Study
PSYC 144 Memory and Amnesia 
PSYC 168 Psychological Disorders of Childhood

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: PSYC 144 Memory and Amnesia har onlineforelæsninger hvilket giver fleksibilitet ift. at man kan se forelæsningerne, når det passer en, samt gense dem hvis nødvendigt. Derudover var jeg glad for PSYC 199 independent study fordi det muliggjorde at jeg kunne arbejde med en forskningsgruppe. Dog kræver det en del selvstændigt arbejde at etablere kontakten til en forskningsgruppe samt at få det godkendt af både KU og UCSD.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Det er dyrt at bo og leve i San Diego. Et lejet værelse er typisk flere tusinde kroner dyrere end i København. Dog er der mange gratis outdoor aktiviteter - surf, hiking, strand, løbeklubber osv.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Der er stor forskel på priserne i supermarkederne. Nogle er rigtig dyre, så find dem med rimelige priser (Trader Joe's, Vons, Grocery Outlet, Target).

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Mit sociale liv var ikke tilknyttet UCSD, men jeg var heldig at få et socialt netværk at lokale i San Diego.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der er mange muligheder gennem universitetet. Jeg benyttede mig som sagt ikke af universitets aktiviteter, men brugte mere tid med folk udenfor UCSD. Men UCSD har mange aktiviteter, dog er mange studerende en del yngre.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Outdoor aktiviteter - surf, hiking, løb osv.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Der er mange muligheder i og omkring San Diego. Hvis man ønsker at få et socialt netværk er der mange løbeklubber og andre sociale klubber, man kan blive en del af.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var nemt. Der er mange unge i San Diego, der er tilflyttere (og ikke mange der er vokset op her), hvilket gør, at de fleste er åbne overfor nye venskaber og generelt er imødekommende og inkluderende.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Mine venner var ikke studerende, men hvis man vil møde venner er løbeklubber en god måde.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: De kulturelle forskelle var ikke som sådan udfordrende men kan indimellem få en til at føle sig fremmed.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Generelt er der en meget inkluderende og imødekommende kultur i San Diego - både overfor venner men også fremmede. Det er langt nemmere at komme ind på livet af folk end i Danmark. Jeg er også meget glad for den outdoor livsstil der er her.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1) San Diego har meget at tilbyde og er enormt smukt naturmæssigt - du behøver ikke "stress-rejse" rundt i hele Californien men kan prioritere lokale oplevelser.
2) Accepter at det nogle gange er hårdt at være langt væk fra Danmark og i en anden tidszone - det er også en del af oplevelsen!
3) Vær ikke bange for at møde op til en løbeklub
el.lign
. alene - der er mange unge i San Diego, der lige er flyttet her til og generelt er folk imødekommende og inkluderende.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Søg forhåndsgodkendelser hos KU i god tid!

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: De venner, jeg har fået.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Det er overvældende til tider at bo i et andet land, navigere et andet uddannelsessystem etc.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
